mentions.name: Gmail Agent Access Proxy
mentions.description: A proxy server that gives an AI agent access to the author's Gmail with granular, user-defined permissions, e.g. allowing the agent to create filters and apply custom labels while blocking it from sending messages to trash.
mentions.problem: The author's inbox is 99% full after years of giving their email out to every company on the web, so they want to safely delegate email cleanup to an agent without granting unrestricted access.
mentions.audience: Personal use: the author's own Gmail account and inbox
mentions.source_excerpt: A proxy server to give my agent access to my Gmail with permissions as granular as I like. Like can create filters to custom label but not send to trash.

evidence.value: A proxy server to give my agent access to my Gmail with permissions as granular as I like. Like can create filters to custom label but not send to trash.
